text: The official Jeevan Pramaan download page says the client application is intended for pensioners' Digital Life Certificate registration. For Android, it lists Android 10 or later on an unrooted device, the Jeevan Pramaan app, and AadhaarFaceRD for face authentication. A registered-device service is also needed when fingerprint or iris hardware is used. For iOS, it lists iOS 14 or later on an unrooted device, the Jeevan Pramaan app and AadhaarFaceRD. Mobile face authentication uses the phone camera and does not require an external biometric device; the page says iOS currently supports face authentication only.
title: Jeevan Pramaan - mobile app requirements

text: For help with Jeevan Pramaan application installation or Digital Life Certificate registration, the official download page lists the helpdesk telephone number 1800 111 555 and the email address jeevanpramaan@gov.in.
title: Jeevan Pramaan - official helpdesk
